name: White monkey
slug: Koji's small child at the keep, called the little one.
description: A small figure at the keep, called the little one. The DM identifies him as Koji's child. Whether he is a monk or a special fighter is unresolved.

log.summary: While the party tries to name who lives at the keep, Sylan tries to place the white monkey and cannot remember whether he is a monk or only a special fighter. Ord calls him the little one and asks for his father's name, which the DM gives as Koji.
notes: Small figure at the keep, called the little one. Sylan could not remember whether he is a monk or a special fighter. The DM names his father as Koji.

openQuestions: Is the white monkey a monk or a special fighter?
